mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_safety_rule (rule_type, rule_pattern, rule_action, replacement, description, is_active, sort_order, updated_by) VALUES (#{ruleType}, #{rulePattern}, #{ruleAction}, #{replacement}, #{description}, #{isActive}, #{sortOrder}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_ai_safety_rule WHERE is_active = 1 AND rule_type = #{ruleType} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT * FROM t_ai_safety_rule WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY rule_type, sort_order
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_safety_rule SET rule_pattern = #{rulePattern}, rule_action = #{ruleAction}, replacement = #{replacement}, description = #{description}, is_active = #{isActive}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ai_safety_rule SET is_active = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_ai_safety_rule SET is_active = #{isActive}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
